posts.title: Before You Let the Agent Build It
posts.description: A detailed plan can make a bad idea look very organised. Why I make coding agents defend the plan, inspect the existing code and prove what they changed.

posts.title: Are You Still Paying for Docs?
posts.description: Beautiful docs are worth caring about. Renting the machinery to publish them is a separate question. What the typesetting upheaval tells us about the next documentation invoice.

posts.title: The Work Never Finishes
posts.description: I can have five or six AI agents working and still feel behind. On building businesses, martial arts, and the habit of making rest something you have to earn.
